name: Stack Overflow Bugs
essence: A call stack that never unwinds, or a heap that never stops growing, runs out of room.

examples.summary: Dependency resolution recurses without a visited set; a cycle recurses until the stack limit.
examples.expected_behavior: error: dependency cycle app -> db -> driver -> app

examples.summary: Retry is implemented as unbounded self-recursion; a persistent outage overflows the stack.
examples.mechanism: No attempt cap or base case besides success (CWE-674).

examples.summary: Recursive count over an `Rc` graph with a cycle never terminates.
examples.mechanism: Shared ownership makes cycles easy; recursion lacks a visited set (CWE-674).

examples.summary: Dropping a million-node `Box` linked list recurses once per node and overflows the stack.
examples.mechanism: Compiler-generated Drop for nested Box is recursive; implement an iterative Drop.
examples.observed_output:
recorded 1000000 edits
thread 'main' has overflowed its stack

examples.summary: A 16 MiB array is allocated on the stack, exceeding the 8 MiB main-thread stack.
examples.mechanism: Fixed-size arrays live on the stack (CWE-121); use Vec/Box.

examples.summary: Recursive deep clone follows a back-reference forever.
examples.mechanism: No seen-set for cyclic object graphs (CWE-674).
examples.observed_output: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
examples.expected_behavior: cloned object with the cycle preserved

examples.summary: Spreading a million-element array into `Math.max` exceeds the argument stack.
examples.mechanism: Spread arguments are pushed onto the call stack.
examples.observed_output: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded

examples.summary: Two event handlers re-emit each other's event synchronously, recursing forever.
examples.mechanism: EventEmitter dispatch is synchronous; feedback loops recurse on the stack.
examples.observed_output: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded

examples.summary: Each failed job is re-enqueued twice with no attempt cap, doubling the queue every round.
examples.mechanism: Runaway allocation from uncapped retries (CWE-770); heap exhaustion follows.

examples.summary: Walking a node that points at itself raises RecursionError.
examples.mechanism: The next link is the node itself, so the recursive walk never reaches a base case.
examples.expected_behavior: a walk that stops on a repeated node

examples.summary: left and right call each other with no base case and raise RecursionError.
examples.mechanism: Each function's only path calls the other, so the stack grows on every hop.

examples.summary: A failed send retries by calling itself and raises RecursionError.
examples.mechanism: The retry is a direct recursive call with no attempt limit.
examples.expected_behavior: one send, or a bounded number of retries
